confidence_notes: Medium overall. Beer, coffee and meal anchors are judgement blends of Brno-specific aggregated sources (Numbeo's Brno index and a World-prices 2026 Brno page), some of which are crowd-sourced or dated, so they are the most reliable. Cocktail rests on an Expatistan Brno figure, a nightlife-guide range and a May 2026 Brno cocktail-week price. Wine by the glass and accommodation are least certain: wine is weakly sourced and set at about 1.75x the beer anchor, and accommodation is a general-knowledge estimate for July high season with no booking pages or listings checked. Koruna prices were converted at roughly 21-22 CZK per USD from general knowledge, not a looked-up rate. FX: the latest RBA observation surfaced by the one permitted RBA search is 0.7088 USD per AUD as at 2026-03-20, as reported in search results for the RBA exchange-rate page. The live daily table could not be accessed, so this may not be the latest observation for 2026-11-19. A later third-party figure of 0.703 for 2026-07-31 was not verified against rba.gov.au and is not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors rest on Brno-specific sources, and the wine anchor is tied to pour-size listings of uncertain Brno attribution. Accommodation is a holistic general-knowledge estimate for a mid-sized Czech city in July.
